description: Wait for the next verification email in an inbox and return just the one-time code and/or the verification / magic / password-reset link. The fastest way to finish a signup or login. Waits up to timeout_seconds for the email to arrive.

from.description: Only match senders containing this text, e.g. "github.com". Recommended when the inbox gets other mail.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the email (default 60).

name: get_verification
title: Get verification code or link
